description: Smart Flex Effector with pose and acceleration readout and a motor lock, over Modbus RTU
source: Bosch Rexroth Smart Flex Effector Modbus Documentation, firmware version 1.41.0 (updated 2023-05-24)

sources.title: Modbus Documentation - Smart Flex Effector (sfe_customer_documentation.html), firmware 1.41.0

notes: Input registers are read-only (function 04); holding registers are read and write (function 03, 06, 16, 23); write-only holding registers are actions that do something when 1 is written. Function 20 (read file record, for the error log and logger data) and function 43 (read device identification) are not register reads and are not mapped.
Multi-register values are big-endian with the high word first (UINT32 2974880010 is [45393, 4362]); floats are IEEE 754 in two registers. The manual shows 'BOOL' registers as 0 or 1.
The device identification (function 43) objects are: 0 vendor name, 1 serial number, 2 firmware version, 3 vendor URL, 4 product name, 5 model name, 128 bootloader version.

Writes can be refused without a Modbus exception: the cause (wrong mode, storage protection against frequent EEPROM writes, invalid value, processing error) is then in 'Last command status' (input 51). A rejected value also discards the other registers of the same Write Multiple Registers frame.

Only quality threshold set 0 is listed; there are ten sets of 12 floats (24 registers) from 1010 to 1249. The 36 RGB LED registers at 1262 to 1369 (3 per LED) and the logger data and error log records are described in the manual.

The manual gives no factory serial format (data bits, parity, stop bits) or default address and baud rate; baud rates 9600, 38400, 115200 and 921600 are accepted. Set the connection to match the device. The motor timeout and velocity units are not stated in the manual.
The documentation is for firmware 1.41.0. The Modbus RTU interface only answers when 'Protocol mode' is MODBUS; the device also speaks a text protocol.
